note: Macon County Conservation District campground near Cisco, in open woods above Friends Creek. Every pad is at least 40 ft; potable water spigots around the loops for filling tanks. Recreational camping only: no residential stays (long stays only for people working in the area, by staff assignment). Clinton Lake fishing 8 miles north. --Claude
